fields.Name: ORD-36 - Progress Measurement
fields.Description: Percentage-of-completion revenue recognition by attested catch-up (AIDP-26, golive #241, plan Part F, D90). Proves the cumulative arithmetic ties exactly at 100% with a backward slide posting a negative delta through the mirrored entry, that a POC line books to Deferred Revenue and stages no recognition at booking, that Preview writes nothing, that a posted observation is immutable, that an unchanged percent is a success with no entry, that a non-POC line or a backdated observation is refused, that a date after the current business month warns and still posts, and that a supervisor can supersede the latest observation — reversing it on its own date and unfreezing the line — while anyone without the grant, or any older or already-superseded observation, is refused.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 40/70/55/100 posts four entries summing to the line with the third negative and the last landing the odd cent, and RecognizedToDateAfter agrees with the ledger at each step; a POC line books Dr AR / Cr Deferred with no releases; Preview leaves observation rows and journal entries unchanged; a posted observation refuses update (trigger); an unchanged percent writes an observation but no entry; a straight-line line and an observation dated before the last posted one are refused with a reason; a far-future date posts with a FutureDateWarning; a supersede of a mistyped future date nets that date's entries to zero, leaves the replaced row Posted and untouched, restores the line to the replacement's percent, and lets the next month post; supersede without the grant, of a non-latest row, or twice, is refused; the worklist shows the replacement as last attested; a mistyped 100% is found on the complete worklist and superseded on its own date while a second ordinary row on that date is still refused; and with an invoice between the mistake and its supersede, Sales nets to zero on the mistaken date and the line's end balances match a control line never mistyped.
